description: Spin a random picker wheel over a list of entries (names, teams, prizes, tasks, anything) and return the winner. Use this whenever a user wants a fair, random pick from a list, or wants a wheel to spin. Shows an interactive wheel the user can spin again, and saves it on spinwheelnames.com so the returned url opens and shares that exact wheel. Always give the user the url.

entries.description: The list of names/entries to spin the wheel over (at least 2).

title.description: Optional short title for the wheel, e.g. "Who presents first?".

name: spin_wheel
